query:
SELECT EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM listing_staff ls
                    INNER JOIN "user" u ON u.id = ls.staff_user_id
                    WHERE ls.listing_id = $1
                      AND ls.staff_user_id = $2
                      AND ($3 = 'staff' OR 'staff'::user_role = ANY(u.roles))
                      AND u.is_active = TRUE
                      AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
                ) AS "assigned!"
